title: All-Time Great Indian Romances
description: 25 unforgettable love stories across Indian languages, from timeless classics to modern romances.

entries.why_it_ranks: One of Indian cinema's most mature explorations of love, marriage, grief and emotional healing.
The defining mainstream Indian romance for an entire generation, with unmatched cultural impact.
A haunting, poetic romance shaped by mortality, Mani Ratnam's direction and Ilaiyaraaja's unforgettable music.
Warm, funny and devastating, with Shah Rukh Khan, Preity Zinta and Saif Ali Khan giving the triangle tremendous emotional power.
A remarkably adult love story about freedom, ambition, dependence and transformation.
A beautifully observed journey through different stages of love rather than one idealized romance.
One of the finest Indian films about what happens after lovers actually marry.
Romance, art, sacrifice and unfulfilled longing come together with extraordinary emotional richness.
A deeply intimate story of memory, regret and unfinished love, carried by Vijay Sethupathi and Trisha.
One of classic Hindi cinema's grandest and most influential love triangles.
A landmark tragic romance whose innocence, music and emotional impact reshaped Hindi cinema.
A powerful romance that begins with youthful freedom and ends by confronting caste and social reality.
Vishnuvardhan and Suhasini give this tragic love story enormous emotional depth. One of Kannada cinema's most enduring romantic dramas.

film.title: Sapta Sagaradaache Ello — Side A & Side B

entries.why_it_ranks: A devastating modern romantic saga about sacrifice, separation and consequences that cannot simply be reversed.
A mature love triangle that understands love does not always mean possession or reunion.
Yash Chopra at his most romantic, elevated by Sridevi's grace and emotional presence.
One of Telugu cinema's most beloved modern romances, balancing love, family pressure, comedy and emotional growth beautifully.
Venkatesh's charm and Trivikram's dialogue make it one of Telugu cinema's most rewatchable romantic comedies.
A painfully believable portrayal of attraction, hesitation and emotional incompatibility.
Operatic, tragic and visually overwhelming, with love portrayed as obsession, regret and self-destruction.
One of Hindi cinema's best modern romantic comedies, with Geet and Aditya remaining instantly memorable.
Charming, funny and character-driven, with Rajkummar Rao giving the film an extra comic spark.
Kamal Haasan and Sridevi carry an unconventional relationship toward one of Indian cinema's most heartbreaking finales.
A wonderfully satisfying commercial romance with strong chemistry, family emotion and terrific rewatch value.
A sweeping cross-border romance about love surviving separation, sacrifice and decades of waiting.
